summary: Approve with notes: confirm the items below.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Rated life (L70)
findings.detail: LED estimated useful life of at least 50,000 hours at 70 percent lumen maintenance, from IES LM-80 data.
findings.why_it_matters: Without verified life data, we can’t be sure the lights will last as long as expected on site.

findings.title: Warranty
findings.detail: Package states 5 years; spec requires at least 5 yr.

highlights.quote: WARRANTY — 5-year limited warranty. Complete warranty terms located at:  www.acuitybrands.com/support/customer-support/terms-and-conditions

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: DLC listing
findings.detail: Listed as a qualified DLC product, where applicable.
findings.why_it_matters: Missing DLC proof could affect energy rebates or compliance with local efficiency programs.

findings.title: macadam steps
findings.detail: Package states 3; spec requires at most 3.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Dims down to
findings.detail: Continuous dimming from 100 to 5 percent without flicker.
findings.why_it_matters: If the dimming isn’t smooth and flicker-free, it could cause issues with lighting controls or occupant comfort.

findings.title: Different revision found; no quoted values changed
findings.detail: Submitted Rev. 07/01/19, web source Rev. 08/14/25. The revision labels differ; their age order is not confirmed.
findings.why_it_matters: Just having a different revision date doesn’t mean one is newer or that anything changed—we need actual values to compare.
